About Wallpaper Clock

Lightweight, high-performance desktop wallpaper clock for Windows.

⏱

Wallpaper Clock

Version 1.0.0 (Windows x64 Native)

Backend Rust (Tauri v2)
Layer Tech Windows WorkerW / HWND_BOTTOM
Idle RAM < 50 MB
Idle CPU ~0.0%

Embedded directly into the Windows desktop wallpaper surface below desktop icons. Fully click-through, hardware accelerated, zero busy loops, and pauses automatically when fullscreen games run.

Keyboard Shortcuts

Ctrl + Alt + C Toggle Interactive / Edit Mode
Esc Exit Edit Mode
